definition: Merchandise value of items sold, excluding shipping.
caveat: Not revenue and not profit: no cost, tax, refund or commission data exists in this dataset.

definition: Shipping charged, reported separately from merchandise.
caveat: Never added to items_value without saying so; the sum is labelled items_plus_freight.

definition: Cash collected across all payment instruments.
caveat: Differs from items_plus_freight because of instalments, vouchers and rounding; the two are never used interchangeably.

definition: Average value of merchandise per order.
filter_applied: is_sale_eligible AND in_analysis_window AND items_value IS NOT NULL
denominator: orders with at least one item
caveat: Orders with no items (775, mostly unavailable) would drag the mean toward zero if counted.
Uses customer_unique_id. customer_id would inflate this by the repeat-purchase rate (2,997 repeat customers).

definition: Share of delivered orders that arrived after the promised date.
denominator: delivered orders having both a delivery date and an estimate
caveat: Excludes 8 orders marked delivered with no delivery timestamp, and every non-delivered status. Compared at DATE granularity.

definition: Calendar days between promised date and actual delivery.
caveat: Negative means early. Reported as median and p90, not mean: the distribution has a long right tail.

definition: Share of orders that received a review.
caveat: Reviews are voluntary, so scores describe reviewers, not all customers.

definition: Average star rating, one review per order.
caveat: Multiple reviews per order collapsed to the most recent (547 orders affected, 202 with disagreeing scores).

definition: Share of reviewed orders rated 1 or 2 stars.
caveat: The operationally actionable tail; a mean of 4.1 hides it.
